outcome.observed_limitation: At the normal 72 KiB response budget, compaction removed every observation, hypothesis, and improvement row from a page whose four source records had all been integrity-verified. The resulting projection exposed the counts but not the linked path needed to inspect the evidence.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Normal-size ECI compaction can remove every row in an available evidence path
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment ECI campaign evidence compaction
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The live main projection considered and integrity-verified four selected campaign observations, including one pressure hypothesis and one improvement relation, but compacted all corresponding rows out of its bounded response.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When it fits the declared output budget, preserve one complete occurrence-to-hypothesis-to-improvement path with its exact verification and follow-up references, while disclosing secondary omissions and retaining bounded session context.
pressure_hypothesis.recurrence: one selected session and one evidence page; recurrence across sessions not established
not_measured: agent receipt or use of the omitted evidence
agent intervention burden or productivity impact
recurrence across agents, sessions, or evidence pages
whether the missing rows caused any prior implementation delay

measurement_limits: The projection identities are readback identities for one active session and are not stable service identifiers.
The 158069-byte value is the source response byte count; the 63869-byte value is the final CLI JSON response size.
The source response truncation flag describes bounded source detail and does not establish loss of the four selected evidence records.
No agent receipt, fallback action, or intervention cost was measured.
